outcome: Let an ontology reviewer deterministically evaluate whether one proposed directed ontology edge is supported by exact frozen Lean declaration bindings and the selected direction rule, while keeping the result candidate-only and non-authoritative.
scope: Own the product meaning for exact Lean-source binding, typed-edge direction validation, deterministic rejection, and reviewable candidate-evidence emission for one bounded edge request.
exclusions: proving or elaborating arbitrary Lean source
selecting canonical ontology meanings or semantic owners
admitting, promoting, publishing, releasing, or deploying an ontology
treating a passing validation as implementation acceptance or conformance

owner_routes.owner: Lean Ontology Evidence Compiler runtime owner unselected
Semantic owner of the candidate ontology use remains unselected

revision_history.change: Created the first candidate capability for deterministic typed-edge validation against exact Lean declaration evidence.

challenge_route: Challenge product meaning through the Ontology Product owner, definition meaning through definitions-governance, typed-edge fidelity through the future semantic owner, and implementation or conformance through their separate owners.
claim_limit: Candidate Product Capability only; no adoption, ontology admission, implementation acceptance, conformance, publication, release, deployment, or external effect.
